title: Zugzwang
line: When every move makes it worse, the side to move loses.

steps.text: Each king attacks the other's pawn and guards its own. Whoever has to move must step away from its pawn, and loses it.
Having to move when every move makes things worse is zugzwang. A spare pawn move can hand the turn over.
Use your spare pawn so that Black runs out of moves first. Mind how far it goes.

wrong.h2h3: Black's pawn steps forward to meet yours, and then you are the one who has to move.
wrong.c5b5: Your king has to leave its pawn, and the black king takes it.

steps.hint: A pawn on its first move may go two squares.
steps.after: Both pawns are stuck. Black has only king moves, and each one gives up the pawn.
Black's pawn is gone, and your pawn is free to walk up.

summary: In zugzwang, every move makes things worse. Spare pawn moves decide who runs out first.
